comment: The one shape-based helper for the paths a tool use writes (src/tools/shared/writtenPaths.ts): Write/Edit by file_path + content/new_string, Patch by its headers — Add, Update, Delete and both sides of a Move. Its users: the extraction's skip check and written-path list (extractMemories.ts), the transcript badge's memory-write classification (collapseReadSearch.ts), and the format guard's index scan (the regexes).

probes.name: a Patch writes the paths its headers name
a Move destination is a written path
an Update header is a written path
a Delete header is a written path
a header path is trimmed, an empty one dropped
a CRLF patch reads its headers
a file_path alone is a read, not a write
an Edit's new_string makes its file_path a write
a relative path resolves against the cwd given
a path named twice is listed once
the extraction reads written paths through the helper, Patch included
probes.replace:
const input = block.input as { file_path?: unknown } | undefined
  return block.type === 'tool_use' && typeof input?.file_path === 'string' ? [input.file_path] : []

probes.name: the badge reads a memory write through the helper, Patch included
a Patch is a memory write only when every path it writes is a memory file
the guard's index scan reads Patch headers with the helper's regexes
probes.replace: const move = null as RegExpExecArray | null
